definitions.explanation: A caffeine-free tea brewed from dried burdock root, drunk in Japan as a health beverage.

examples.japanese: {牛蒡茶|ごぼうちゃ}を{飲|の}む。
{母|はは}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{牛蒡茶|ごぼうちゃ}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: My mother makes burdock tea every morning.

examples.japanese: {牛蒡茶|ごぼうちゃ}は{体|からだ}を{温|あたた}める{健康茶|けんこうちゃ}として{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Burdock tea is popular as a health tea said to warm the body.

notes:
Made by steeping dried, often roasted burdock root. It contains no caffeine and is marketed as a {健康茶|けんこうちゃ} (health tea), valued for fiber and a mild, earthy flavor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牛蒡茶|ごぼうちゃ}を{入|い}れる: to make burdock tea
- {牛蒡茶|ごぼうちゃ}を{煮出|にだ}す: to brew burdock tea by boiling

RELATED WORDS:
- {牛蒡|ごぼう}: burdock (the root vegetable itself)
- {健康茶|けんこうちゃ}: health tea — herbal teas drunk for wellbeing
